summary: D4, D5, the D3 single-cut conditional transfer, and two D3 cuts sharing their unique outside hole are sound for arbitrary K(Q6) prescribed matchings, modulo frozen Q5 T44 and general two-hole inputs.

PROOF_PACKAGE.md.precise_imports: A2 same-parity two-hole omission, general two-hole free-root path, balanced two-hole spanning circle for dimension five

exactscope.matching: arbitrary K(Q6) matching with one minority hole a, five majority holes, and two specified distinct majority omissions x,y
exactscope.D4: A coordinate face contains exactly four majority holes including x,y, and excludes a
exactscope.D5: A coordinate face contains all five majority holes, excludes a, and a is nonadjacent to all three included majority holes
exactscope.D3_single: A coordinate face contains a and four majority holes including x,y; a nonadjacent to all three included majority holes; completion unless the sole crossing has B endpoint mirror(a)
exactscope.D3_universal: Two distinct D3 cuts share the same unique opposite-side original hole; then every matching realizing this marked geometry completes
exactscope.conclusion: A simple 62-cycle exactly omitting x,y and containing all prescribed edges; only added edges short

obligations.obligation: Both original face hole sets and even crossing parity; auxiliary D fills exactly A ports and leaves precisely four majority holes.
Positive crossing T44 cycle minus nonempty D gives a path forest; opposite-face matching has exactly balanced holes a,b; circle extension and expansion.

Zero crossing mirror of b is covered; incident nonprescribed cycle edge is short; opposite face root path closes by optional short edge; both removed edges are unprescribed; two-bridge join has 62 vertices.
Odd positive crossing; three mirror candidates covered and distinct; at c=1 at least two avoid the sole B port.
Auxiliary pairing contains td when the chosen mirror is occupied; valid because t is a hole and d a distinct port; remaining port count is even; T44 hypotheses hold.
Internal mirror forest; original partner k is internal and outside R endpoints; suppression has no loop or repeated endpoint and leaves exactly same-parity holes a,w.
Occupied mirror requires c>=3 and at least two D edges; the forced td edge and another removed cycle edge separate t,d; added bridge joins components; compressed endpoint set is X_B minus {w}.
A2 omits w; expansion restores w and all 30 included A vertices, preserves F, deletes auxiliary edges, and yields exactly 62 vertices with only new short edges.

Unique B hole b differs from mirror w by nonadjacency; c is positive odd; safe and occupied branches have the exact D5 topological structure with special a replacing t and omitted B hole b replacing a.
c=1 with w as sole B port is the unique untreated single-cut branch; its deletion/attachment closes a separate A-side component, so it is properly excluded.
Two distinct D3 coordinates sharing b give a 16-vertex intersection S with exactly one original hole b, hence 15 covered vertices.

Every edge leaving S crosses at least one cut; its S endpoint would have to equal the exceptional mirror for that cut, but that mirror is outside the other B face. This applies to long edges crossing both coordinates too.
No edge leaves S, so a matching would have to pair all 15 covered vertices internally, impossible; at least one cut is nonexceptional for every F.
Arbitrary prescribed matching edges, including long and same-parity edges, preserved; no full Q5/Q6 T15 or Q6 T44 assumption and no dependency cycle.

topology_regression.scope: Finite topology regression and all Q6 coordinate-intersection exit edges; not a replacement for the universal symbolic matching argument.
